title: Listening Drill — Rainwater tanks
description: Short academic talk. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Rainwater tanks
sections.transcript:
PRESENTER: Today I'm describing a small study of rainwater tanks at primary schools. I want you to listen for how the researchers measured change, because the result is easy to overstate.

PRESENTER: Their work took place at schools with similar roof areas. Instead of relying on what local people remembered, they recorded water levels. They noticed slower refilling. That observation would have been missed if the team had visited only at the end.

PRESENTER: The largest limitation was blocked gutters. The report is therefore a starting point. In a follow-up, the team would add gutter inspections. A wider study could show whether the original pattern holds.
